note: metal capabilities fail clears supported, so the status note cannot say what would run
metal capabilities fail leaves healthy true, so the dispatcher keeps routing to a dead device
metal capabilities recover keeps lastError, so the status note still shows a stale failure
metal capabilities effective supports ignores health, so a failed backend still gets ops
metal capabilities recover leaves healthy false, so the dispatcher never returns to Metal
metal capabilities effective supports keeps compiling families, so a cold family stalls on its compile instead of drawing on the cpu
metal capabilities finish compiling keeps the family out, so a warmed family never returns to supports
metal capabilities start compiling holds nothing out, so a family runs before its pipelines are built
